findings.text: non-blocking: the helper resolves the plan file inline as `<mounted docs>/plans/<slug>.html`, duplicating a capability the repository already owns at reckon/crew/plan_review.py:1538 `_plan_document_path` (which resolves through `resolve_resource` and returns None rather than raising), and duplicating the composer's own lookup at reckon/crew/plan_review.py:4692-4697; if either resolution is later widened, the remedy and the composer disagree again and the printed command refuses — exactly the defect this node closes — so the fallback should consult the same resolver the composer uses.

non-blocking: the guard catches (CrewError, OSError, ValueError, KeyError) but `flight.mounted_project_docs()` raises `flight.FlightConfigError` (reckon/flight.py:207), which is a plain Exception and not a CrewError, so a malformed mounts file would escape an advisory block documented at reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py:838-845 as refusing nothing — the sibling advisory reads in the same function (list_code_reviews at :915-917) are guarded, and reckon/crew/dispatch_plan.py:1382 catches FlightConfigError explicitly at the same call.
